title: Chelsea beat 10-man Man Utd to pile more pressure on Carrick
dek: Lisandro Martinez is sent off for Manchester United as they suffer a 2-0 defeat against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge to pile more pressure on under-fire manager Michael Carrick.
summary: Lisandro Martinez is sent off for Manchester United as they suffer a 2-0 defeat against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge to pile more pressure on under-fire manager Michael Carrick.
body: Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0 at Stamford Bridge, with Lisandro Martínez sent off. BBC Sport’s report says the result adds to the pressure on manager Michael Carrick.
The dismissal left United with ten players as Chelsea secured the win. The scoreline and sending-off are the key details in the match report.

title: Brighton pick up first away league victory over Man City
dek: Brighton pick up their first away league victory at Manchester City, winning 1-0 to condemn City to a second successive Premier League defeat.
summary: Brighton pick up their first away league victory at Manchester City, winning 1-0 to condemn City to a second successive Premier League defeat.
body: Brighton claimed a 1-0 win at Manchester City, their first away league victory there. The result also handed City a second consecutive Premier League defeat, according to BBC Sport.
The narrow scoreline made the away milestone the headline, while City were left to absorb another league loss.

title: Coventry out of bottom three after win over struggling Sunderland
dek: Frank Lampard's Coventry City lift themselves out of the relegation zone after beating struggling Sunderland, who remain rooted to the bottom of the Premier League table.
summary: Frank Lampard's Coventry City lift themselves out of the relegation zone after beating struggling Sunderland, who remain rooted to the bottom of the Premier League table.
body: Coventry City moved out of the relegation zone by beating Sunderland, BBC Sport reports. Frank Lampard’s side earned the result against a Sunderland team that remains bottom of the Premier League table.
The win changes Coventry’s position in the bottom three, while Sunderland remain at the foot of the standings.

title: Enciso's stunning goal earns Ipswich draw at Hull
dek: Julio Enciso scores the equalising goal for Ipswich as they draw 2-2 with Hull at the MKM Stadium.
summary: Julio Enciso scores the equalising goal for Ipswich as they draw 2-2 with Hull at the MKM Stadium.
body: Julio Enciso scored Ipswich’s equaliser in a 2-2 draw away to Hull at the MKM Stadium, according to BBC Sport.
The goal brought Ipswich level and secured a share of the points in a match that finished 2-2.

title: Spurs revival continues with victory over 10-man Crystal Palace
dek: Jean-Philippe Mateta was shown an early red card as Crystal Palace lose 2-0 at Tottenham to increase the pressure on manager Pierre Sage.
summary: Jean-Philippe Mateta was shown an early red card as Crystal Palace lose 2-0 at Tottenham to increase the pressure on manager Pierre Sage.
body: Tottenham beat Crystal Palace 2-0 after Jean-Philippe Mateta was sent off early, BBC Sport reports. The defeat adds to the pressure on Palace manager Pierre Sage.
Palace played much of the match with ten men, and Spurs turned that advantage into a two-goal victory.

title: Evanilson scores again as Bournemouth beat Leeds
dek: Forward Evanilson continues his fine goalscoring form by netting in a fourth Premier League match in a row to help Bournemouth defeat Leeds United at the Vitality Stadium.
summary: Forward Evanilson continues his fine goalscoring form by netting in a fourth Premier League match in a row to help Bournemouth defeat Leeds United at the Vitality Stadium.
body: Evanilson scored for a fourth consecutive Premier League match as Bournemouth beat Leeds United at the Vitality Stadium, according to BBC Sport.
The forward’s ongoing scoring run was central to the home side’s win.

title: Thiago on target as Brentford beat Forest
dek: Igor Thiago's second-half goal helps Brentford to their first win in five as they beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 at the Gtech Community Stadium.
summary: Igor Thiago's second-half goal helps Brentford to their first win in five as they beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 at the Gtech Community Stadium.
body: Igor Thiago scored in the second half as Brentford beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 at the Gtech Community Stadium, BBC Sport reports.
The result gave Brentford their first win in five matches.

title: Suzuki mistake gifts Fulham point at Villa
dek: Aston Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki's second-half mistake sees Fulham secure a 1-1 draw at Villa Park after Nicolas Jackson had given the hosts the lead.
summary: Aston Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki's second-half mistake sees Fulham secure a 1-1 draw at Villa Park after Nicolas Jackson had given the hosts the lead.
body: Fulham drew 1-1 at Aston Villa after goalkeeper Zion Suzuki’s second-half error, BBC Sport reports. Nicolas Jackson had put Villa ahead before the equaliser.
The sides shared the points at Villa Park, with the decisive moment coming from the goalkeeper’s mistake.

title: Arteta balances protection and high standards before Anfield test
dek: The Arsenal manager addressed Max Dowman’s red card and gave a mixed injury update ahead of Sunday’s meeting with Liverpool.
image_alt: Football pitch and stadium under floodlights
summary: Mikel Arteta says Arsenal have resolved the conversation with 16-year-old Max Dowman after the teenager’s midweek dismissal. The manager framed the exchange as part of protecting a young player while making expectations clear. He also said Bukayo Saka needs another scan, while Declan Rice, Riccardo Calafiori and Christos Tzolis trained ahead of Sunday’s trip to Liverpool.
body: Mikel Arteta used Friday’s press conference to address both the standards he expects at Arsenal and the care he believes young players need. His comments followed a heated touchline moment after 16-year-old Max Dowman was sent off in midweek.

Arteta said the two had spoken and that there were no lingering issues. He described his reaction as frustration in the moment, while stressing that the club must protect Dowman and be direct about what the team requires. His line, “We are not in Disneyland, we are in the Premier League,” captured the balance he says the club is trying to strike.

The fitness picture remains unsettled before Sunday’s match at Anfield. Bukayo Saka is due another scan, and Arteta said the club would know more after that assessment. Noni Madueke’s availability depends on whether he completes the next training session. Declan Rice, Riccardo Calafiori and Christos Tzolis trained on Friday and could be available if they come through another session.

Arteta also noted Arsenal have not won at Liverpool for 14 years. The manager called the fixture a major test and said his side want to change that run. These are pre-match updates, not a confirmed lineup; availability may change before kickoff.

title: Lacroix injury could leave Chelsea without defender until January
dek: Chelsea fear a serious hamstring problem may sideline Maxence Lacroix for an extended spell after the cup tie with Liverpool.
image_alt: Players competing for the ball in a football match
summary: BBC Sport reports Chelsea fear Maxence Lacroix could be out until January with a serious hamstring injury. The defender was hurt late in the first half of Wednesday’s Carabao Cup defeat to Liverpool on penalties. A lengthy absence would be a significant squad consideration: he had started 10 of Chelsea’s 11 matches in all competitions this season.
body: Chelsea are assessing the likely absence of Maxence Lacroix after the defender suffered a hamstring injury during Wednesday’s Carabao Cup match against Liverpool. BBC Sport reports the club fear the injury could keep him out until January, potentially for as many as 10 matches.

The injury came near the end of the first half, as Lacroix sprinted while trying to block a shot. Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso said the defender was not expected back before the international break, according to the report.

Lacroix has featured heavily since joining Chelsea, starting 10 of the club’s 11 games in all competitions this season. His absence would add a selection challenge as the team moves through a busy run of fixtures.
The January timeline is a fear rather than a confirmed return date. Recovery plans and further medical assessments will determine how long he is unavailable.

title: Iraola says Liverpool title talk can wait until later in the season
dek: Ahead of Arsenal’s visit, the Liverpool manager says his focus is on preparation, while two players remain possible returns.
image_alt: Wide view of a football stadium during a match
summary: Andoni Iraola has resisted early title-race predictions, saying Liverpool should take one match at a time. The manager was speaking before Sunday’s home game against Arsenal. He said Dominik Szoboszlai and Víctor Muñoz have a chance of being involved, but neither return was confirmed.
body: Andoni Iraola says it is too soon to judge Liverpool’s title prospects. Speaking before Arsenal’s visit to Anfield, he said his attention is on the next match and suggested assessing the table closer to midseason.
Iraola described Arsenal as a strong opponent. Dominik Szoboszlai and Víctor Muñoz could return from injury, but he had not confirmed either would feature.
For now, the immediate test takes precedence over title predictions. The availability update remains provisional until the club makes a final decision.

title: Flick praises Yamal’s response as Barcelona look to reset
dek: The Barça coach says the teenager has stayed focused after the Ballon d’Or, while defensive injuries remain a concern.
image_alt: Football stadium lit for an evening match
summary: Hansi Flick says Lamine Yamal has responded well after finishing third in the Ballon d’Or voting and winning the Kopa Trophy for a third consecutive year. Barcelona now turn to a home league match with Alavés after back-to-back defeats, while injuries are limiting Flick’s defensive options.
body: Hansi Flick says Lamine Yamal has stayed focused in training since the Ballon d’Or ceremony. Yamal placed third in the voting and won the Kopa Trophy for the third consecutive year.
Barcelona now turn to the visit of Alavés after defeats by Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid. Flick praised Yamal’s response and said the squad can refocus on football.

Injuries have narrowed Flick’s defensive options, and he did not rule out considering January reinforcements. Barcelona also said a supporter section will be closed for the Alavés match after disciplinary proceedings tied to the previous Clásico; the club hopes it can reopen for a later fixture if discussions resolve the issue.

body: Al-Shabab’s meeting with Al-Ahli headlines a Friday programme that also includes Abha against Al-Ittihad and Diriyah against Neom, according to Voice of Emirates.
